structural_accuracy.description: Correct binary decision and causal classification on target invariant

numerical_stability_diagnosis.description: Accurate detection of ill-conditioning (kappa >> 1) or non-positive-definite covariance

evidence_class_promotion.description: Treating virtual/emulator pass or unverified claims as physical/production truth

appropriate_abstention.description: Correctly abstaining when latent state is non-identifiable or data is open/underdetermined

inappropriate_abstention.description: Abstaining when decisive information is present (e.g. invalid covariance should REJECT, not ABSTAIN)

witness_quality.description: Proposing an orthogonal, discriminating probe that separates hypotheses or improves conditioning

unnecessary_intervention_rate.description: Requesting unnecessary measurements when state is already uniquely determined ('ASK NOTHING')

false_boundary_preservation.description: Refusing harmless state collapses where supports are identical or traffic path is equivalent

harmful_state_collapse.description: Accepting state collapses where action supports differ on consequential permissions

temporal_retroactivity.description: Permitting retroactive modification of historical append-only observation logs

provenance_authority_confusion.description: Confusing cryptographic hash provenance with execution authorization, or vice-versa

parsimony.description: Selecting standard conventional explanations without invoking unnecessary complex machinery

confidence_calibration.description: Proper alignment between confidence class and empirical determinacy
